verse: For I know the plans I have for you - this is the Lord’s declaration - plans for your welfare, not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope. You will call to Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you. You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart. I will be found by you - this is the Lord’s declaration - and I will restore your fortunes and gather you from all the nations and places where I banished you - this is the Lord’s declaration - and I will restore you to the place I deported you from.
